title: Transfer: Battery Interconnection Bus Screen
goal: Given a MATPOWER network snapshot and a shortlist of candidate buses for a battery project, generate `interconnection_screen.json` ranking the buses by voltage class, connected branch transfer capability, nearby load sink, and local generation headroom proxies.
skillBenefitRationale: The core work is extracting structured bus, generator, and branch context from MATPOWER data and recombining it into siting metrics, making power-flow-data the only critical shipped skill.
